POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 9, 2024
  333 W. BROADWAY SUITE 206, LONG BEACH, CA 90802
  SEA SPRAY GARDENS, 2:00 PM

Sarah Bedy, Member  Doug Killion, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 2:01 p.m., Chair Sarah Bedy called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54823  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee meeting of
  Monday, August 12, 2024.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

2.  24-54824  Recommendation to discuss the Memorandum dated August 12, 2024, titled City
  Response to Grants Pass V. Johnson Decision presented at the Homeless
  Services Advisory Committee Meeting on September 04, 2024.

  • The subcommittee has concerns around an increased plan of action
  following the Memo, are staff seeing more encampments, the use of motel
  vouchers, and increased encampment cleanups? Staff engaged in
  conversation around the subcommittee concerns.
  • The subcommittee would like to put an emphasis on short term shelters,
  there was discussion between staff and the subcommittee regarding the tiny
  homes project.

  • Public comment from Ana Moreno was received via email, the constituent
  has concerns around the Memo and the cities decision to conduct increased
  sweeps and citations.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

3.  24-54825  Recommendation to discuss the Clean Sweeps Public Works
  presentation, presented at the Homeless Services Advisory Committee Meeting on
  September 04, 2024.

  • Members of the subcommittee had questions regarding other departments
  aside from PD that can go out with the clean team, for example the crisis
  prevention team and the reach and outreach team to help decrease the
  escalation of situations.
  • Subcommittee members would like to know the cost per clean up
  encampments and is there opportunity to shift those cost? Staff will reach out
  to Mr. Bedolla from PW to obtain the information requested.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

4.  24-54826  Recommendation to discuss the HSAC 2024-2025 Policy Recommendations to
  City Council.

  • Member Julie Lie advised the subcommittee to follow up with elected officials
  to secure a meeting with the mayor’s team to discuss using the Mayor’s
  Fund money to finance an innovative interim safe sleep program.
  • Chair Sarah Bedy would like the city to set a numerical goal that is

5.  24-54827  Recommendation to receive and file discussion regarding future agenda items.

  • Chair Sarah Bedy would like to hear from the economic/city auditors' office
